The Department of Computer Science at The University of Alabama in Huntsville delivers expert instruction in the core design principles of modern computing. Our curriculum covers key technical fields including cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data science, computer architecture, database magement and computer networking.
Problem solving through logical foundations of computing
Computer Science (CS) is the largest department in the College of Science, with modern laboratories for teaching and researching areas in cybersecurity, machine learning and artificial intelligence, data science, gaming and entertainment computing, and digital forensics.
All UAH CS degrees meet national standards for excellence and are fully accredited by the Computing Accreditation Commission of ABET.

Alumni Spotlight
Logan Smith, 2025, BS, Computer Science
"I’m a Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin, working on space‑based missile‑defense software. I write and maintain Python code on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) systems and collaborate closely with hardware and systems teams. My advice for students: get an internship. I was an average student, but the internship I completed during undergrad (shoutout to the SMAP Center!) made the biggest difference in landing my post‑graduation job."
